title: Warm Juicy Turkish Lamb Kunefe
description: A crowd-pleasing Turkish dish featuring lamb, massaman paste, and miso marinate, served in a Korean brass bowl, low in carbs and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together massaman paste, miso paste, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and place it in a Korean brass bowl.
Roll out the kunefe pastry and place it on top of the lamb.
Bake the kunefe in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the kunefe from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
